text:
sophie: quick heads-up — intake for harbor-x-7b landed with two blockers: license has a weird non-commercial-adjacent clause (section 4.b) and our embedding tests show a shape mismatch (got (1,1536) vs expected 768). tagging legal + infra.

aj: ack. can you paste the license snippet? and the failing test output?

sophie: license snippet: "Redistribution permitted for research/non-commercial use; commercial deployment requires written permission; exports may be restricted" — section 4.b mentions a time-limited embargo for some opt-in weights. not clear if cloud API serving counts as "commercial".

sophie: test output:
```
# run: python tests/embeddings_verify.py --model harbor-x-7b
Result: embeddings.shape = (1, 1536)
Expected: (1, 768)
Notes: tokenizer.vocab_size=50257, config.hidden_size=768
```

maria: weird — config.hidden_size=768 but embeddings doubled. could be API returning concat of token-level and pooled vectors? or tokenization change.

liam: could be that the model's embedding head returns CLS+pool? I can run local convert script to inspect. putting on my queue, will ping back in ~90m.

nina-legal: looping in legal. @sophie can you drop the full LICENSE file to the intake ticket? we need to determine if "commercial deployment" includes hosted inference (short answer: depends on wording + precedent). if ambiguous, recommend we mark embargo until clarification.

onboard-bot: intake #4521 updated: status=triage, owners=[maria, liam], docs=attached, embargo_flag=true

ryan-infra: on the deployment side: if license requires opt-in for cloud serving we can implement a soft-block (route requests to dedicated only) while conversation happens. need owners to confirm volume expectations.

devex: small ask — if we put a soft-block, add a warning in console and a flag in SDK so partners see "embargoed model". I can draft UI text.

aj: action items summary:
- sophie: upload LICENSE + sample output to ticket (done?)
- liam: run local inspect + short writeup about why shape is doubled (ETA 90m)
- nina-legal: advise whether hosted counts as commercial or if we can offer dedicated-only (ETA EOD)
- ryan-infra: prepare soft-block plan + config flag (ETA tomorrow)
- devex: draft console/sdk warning copy (ETA tomorrow)
- maria: run perf quick-check across shapes to see if quantization changed embedding dim (ETA 3h)

sophie: license + sample logs attached to ticket now. added note that author contact email is `model-author@org.example`.

liam: quick update — local inspection shows model config has `embedding_dim=768` but forward pass returns two tensors concatenated in the head. looks like export step used `return torch.cat([pool, token_avg], dim=1)` which explains 1536. will open a PR to change head to pooled only for inference builds; meanwhile can we expose the pooled slice in runtime? maybe a compatibility shim.

maria: perf quick-check: embeddings with 1536 dim are ~1.9x memory and ~1.7x latency for downstream index build. quality parity unknown. if we slice to 768 we need to confirm we don't drop signal.

nina-legal: quick read: the license language as-is probably prohibits "public commercial offering" without consent. hosted API likely qualifies. recommend embargo until author confirms or grants explicit hosting rights. we can offer dedicated/private deployment as a path forward. will draft a short email template. ETA EOD.

ryan-infra: infra ok to implement a runtime routing rule that blocks hosted by default for models with embargo_flag=true, routes to dedicated/private. will spec config in PR.

devex: draft warning copy attached to ticket: "Model currently restricted: hosted inference disabled pending license confirmation. Contact support to request dedicated/private hosting." small tweak suggestions welcome.

aj: thanks all. next steps: liam + maria collaborate on a compatibility shim that returns 768-dim pooled embedding plus a full 1536 option behind a flag; nina to pursue license confirmation; infra/devex to gate hosted. we'll reconvene in this thread with PR links and legal reply. :thumbsup:

sophie: thx — adding a note to the launch checklist: `LICENSE_CLARITY=required` and `EMBED_SHAPE=verified` before catalog publish. will update catalog docs accordingly.

liam: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/harborx/compare/shape-shim — comment with runtime toggle `harborx.return_pooled_only=true`.

maria: ran quick eval — pooled-only vs concat: micro-F1 diff <0.5% on our eval set for intent tasks, but retrieval recall drops ~1.2%. recommending we ship pooled-only as default + option to enable full concat for internal customers.

nina-legal: sent email to model-author@org.example requesting written permission for hosting and clarification on embargo. copied product/security. will post reply here when available.

aj: solid. leaving this thread open; please update thread_ts 3587654321 with any PR links or legal replies. closing note: prioritize license clarity before adding model to public catalog.
